body_html: Hey #OpenPedagogy #GoOpen #digped folks at #lra18, I and possibly @chrisaldrich will be hacking on a zamzidat journal. It will be open formative peer reviewed, published on researchers website and syndicated to journal. Hit me up if you wanna get involved.
